summary: Toyota Motor Corp (TMC) filed on Form 6-K announcing the sale of all 74,100,604 shares of Toyota Industries Corp (24.66% stake) to Toyota Fudosan via a share repurchase by Toyota Industries, conditioned on completion of squeeze-out procedures. TMC expects non-consolidated gains of ¥1,206.3 billion and consolidated gains of ¥576.9 billion for FY ending March 2027. The consideration is cash, price per share not stated. No board recommendation or advisor named. The sale is part of a Master Agreement from March 30, 2026 press release. All transactions in TMC's planned tender offer and repurchase are now complete. Watch for any subsequent disclosures on the cash use or further unwinding of cross-shareholdings.
